observations.body: Covenant comparison is spatial, sensory, communal, and Christ-centered rather than a simple old/new label.

observations.body: The passage gives this covenant setting its own action and result.

observations.body: Israel remembered · heavenly assembly · Jesus · Sinai-like mountain · Zion · Sprinkled blood · Two mountain assemblies held together

payload.posture: Read Hebrews 12:18–24 as its own new covenant remembered covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Two mountain assemblies held together inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
